hypotheses.text: Second-line activity is driven by lineage-specific target dependence: e.g., MCF7 (ER+) for LY-2090314, PC3 (AR-) for DPCPX, HT29 for aphidicolin. Choosing a line with high expression of the compound's annotated target should yield one active and one inactive record per compound.

Second-line activity is dominated by shared systematic response (S2) and vehicle-norm threshold effects (S5), not target biology. Any second line may produce a discordant label due to batch, vehicle, or general stress, so line choice is largely arbitrary for maximizing one-active/one-inactive pairs.
